requirements.title: Linear algebra alternative
requirements.summary: Choose MA 305 or MA 405. The table assigns 3 hours to this slot; the alternative row has no separate credit value.

requirements.title: AI/ML elective choices
requirements.summary: Select 6 published hours from this pool. Alternatives separated by 'or' fill the same listed slot. No more than 3 DSA hours count. Credit-unit normalization is unverified; this is not an all-required list.

requirements.title: Open elective choices
requirements.summary: Select 10 published hours from the ECE and other open-elective lists. Slash-labelled catalog entries remain verbatim combined labels, not separately counted courses; listed alternatives fill the same slot. Reuse with host-degree requirements needs review.

requirements.title: Additional advisor-approved open electives
requirements.summary: The open list also permits DSA courses at the 200 level or above, up to 3 credit hours, and College of Science or College of Engineering courses at the 400 level or above with advisor permission. These are open-ended eligibility rules, not a finite omitted course list.

requirements.title: Graduate enrollment GPA
requirements.summary: The catalog requires a minimum 3.5 GPA to enroll in graduate courses.

requirements.title: Recommendations are not extra requirements
requirements.summary: MA 405 is recommended for graduate study. The interest-based open-elective suggestions do not create additional required courses.

requirements.title: Concentration scope
requirements.summary: This inventory covers the AI/ML concentration and its published elective lists. The rest of the host BS and its general education curriculum are outside this concentration record.

requirements.title: Variable source credit amounts
requirements.summary: ECE 492: 1-4 source hours; ECE 591: 1-6 source hours; ECE 592: 1-6 source hours. Exact individual credits remain null.
